name: Situation Pattern
description: Represents a relational context (situation) that includes entities playing roles. A situation is a unified view of a state of affairs.
competency_questions: What is the context of this entity? What entities are involved in this situation?
scenarios: A medical emergency situation involves patients, doctors, and equipment. A business negotiation is a situation with parties and terms.
